thesis: The speakers argue that the business landscape has transitioned from linear models, which rely on internal control and vertical integration, to platform models that facilitate value exchange across fragmented networks. They contend that while platform companies like the FAANGs and private entities such as Uber and Airbnb are currently in early stages, they possess the potential to create new markets and dominate industries over a longer time horizon of 15 to 20 years.
